classification.difficultyReason: The student must use the 53° and 37° marks to decide that the 80 cm side matches the 2 m side. They must then convert units and divide. Only one scale factor is asked for, which keeps it below p19-q3.

content.prompt:
The two triangles are similar.
Calculate the scale factor.

answer.worked:
The equal angles show that the side between $90^\circ$ and $37^\circ$ in the original corresponds to the side between $90^\circ$ and $37^\circ$ in the image. $2\text{ m}=200\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Scale factor}&=\frac{\text{Image length}}{\text{Original length}}\\&=\frac{80}{200}\\&=0.4\end{align*}$$
